title: Cloudify physical package state (schema_version 1)
description: The last confirmed observation of one package instance on one host. One record exists per host, package, and package instance even when several deployments use that installation; active deployment claims live inside it.

host.description: Operator-facing host address in --on grammar: node, node:instance, or the ssh host.

host_key.description: Durable host identity: ivps:<node> or ivps:<node>:<instance> for an inventory host, ssh-sha256:<fingerprint> for an accepted external host.

package.description: Package name as it appears under pkg/.

package_instance.description: Package instance key. The default key is default; a non-default key requires a recipe that declares instance support.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing subject revision. It changes only under the host mutation lock and only together with an event.

applied.description: The last successful install or reconfigure result. A failed attempt never overwrites it.

last_attempt.description: The most recent package operation Cloudify tried, successful or not.

health.description: The last verification observation. It never changes applied values.

claims.description: Active deployment claims on this physical package instance, one per deployment and stable runbook step ID.

component.description: One validated identity path component; rules in schemas/v1/identity.md.

utc.description: UTC timestamp, second precision and trailing Z.

value.description: One declared value held in its comparable source form. A non-secret value keeps its source form, a secret reference keeps the reference, and a literal secret keeps only redaction plus a digest so the plaintext never reaches persisted state.

secret.description: Explicit secret declaration for this value name.

declaration.description: How the secret classification was obtained. heuristic marks a value classified only by the defense-in-depth name heuristic.

source_form.description: The source-form value: a literal, an @@ escaped literal, or a @base64: encoded literal. Null when the plaintext is deliberately not persisted.

reference.description: The @<backend>:<locator> secret reference. Secret references compare by this field.

digest.description: sha256 digest of a literal secret. Literal secrets compare by this field because the plaintext is absent.

redacted.description: True when only a digest of the value is held.

values.description: Declared value names mapped to their comparable forms.

package_version.description: Package version observed at success, or null when the recipe reports none.

application_commit.description: Cloudify commit that produced this applied state, or null when only an old registry record could be migrated or a direct package command ran without deployment context.

at.description: UTC time of the successful operation.

event_id.description: Event that recorded this revision, or null before event writers exist.

values.description: Source-form values that were successfully applied.

attempt.description: The most recent attempt, recorded whether it succeeded or failed.

phase.description: Selected application phase that produced this attempt.

outcome.description: Attempt outcome. An abandoned attempt is classified as interrupted in its run record.

event_id.description: Event that recorded this attempt, or null before event writers exist.

requested.description: Metadata for the values the attempt requested. Literal secrets appear only as digests.

health.description: The last verification observation for this package instance.

status.description: Verification result. unknown means no reliable observation is available.

checked_at.description: UTC time of the verification, or null when never verified.

event_id.description: Event that recorded this verification, or null before event writers exist.

claim.description: One deployment and stable runbook step that relies on this physical package instance. Claims live in an array so the deployment tuple is never flattened into a map key.

step_id.description: Stable runbook step ID that owns this claim.

claimed_at.description: UTC time the claim was added.

run_id.description: Run that added the claim, or null. A claim newer than the manifest is what makes an interrupted commit detectable.

event_id.description: Event that recorded the claim, or null before event writers exist.

values.description: The requested configuration of the claim. Compatibility compares non-secrets by source form, secret references by reference, and literal secrets by digest.
